title: Case 031: Return approved but the customer has no return label

details.data: Entirely synthetic; English; fictional geography; all times UTC

context: The merchant approved a return, but has not issued its printable label. A real synthetic label facsimile is included for exercise completeness, not actual shipping.
initial_request: The return is approved but there is nothing to print in my order. Please obtain my return label.
overview: The escalation snapshot comprises history events 001–002. Event 003 records the next agent action; the subsequent events provide the disclosed calibration follow-through. Facts learned later must not be used as if already known at escalation.

next_action.summary: Ask the merchant's returns team to issue the missing label.

outcome: The customer confirms receipt of a usable label matching the approved return.
boundaries: Label issuance is not return collection, warehouse receipt or refund.

events.body: Return RT-031 for TG-031 / DL-031 is approved. The label field is empty. Our authorised label team needs to issue the label against RT-031 before the customer can prepare the return.
The return is approved but there is nothing to print in my order. Please obtain my return label.
Please issue the missing printable return label for RT-031, matching TG-031 and original shipment DL-031. Send it in the verified returns thread.

events.to: Kessa Ulm, customer; Iona Quill, Rivet Delivery Desk
events.body: Return label RL-031 is issued for RT-031. [Open the synthetic printable label](attachments/return-label.pdf). For this fictional service, place the printed label on the return carton and use the approved drop-off route. The file is an exercise facsimile, not a live shipping label.
I can open and print RL-031. It shows RT-031, TG-031 and DL-031, matching my approved return. I have not dropped the parcel off yet.
